part.text:
Fixed. The issue was in `lib/core/AxiosHeaders.js`:

1. **`normalizeValue`** (lib/core/AxiosHeaders.js:19) stringified everything with `String(value)`, so when response headers were normalized during data transformation, the `set-cookie` array from node's `res.headers` was flattened into one comma-joined string. It now maps arrays recursively and preserves them.

2. **`toJSON`** (lib/core/AxiosHeaders.js:273) always joined array values with `', '`; it now only joins when `asStrings` is explicitly requested, so `headers.toJSON()` preserves the array.

Verified:
- `headers.get('set-cookie')` now returns `['a=1; path=/', 'b=2; path=/']` (also when built from a raw header string)
- `test/unit/regression/bugs.js` (issue #5028) passes
- Full mocha suite: 100 passing, 2 failures (`max content length`, `HTTPS protocol`) which I confirmed also fail on the pristine checkout — they're pre-existing network/environment issues, not regressions
- Karma specs can't run here (Chrome refuses `--no-sandbox` as root, pre-existing environment limitation)
